meta.title: Two triggers for different vendors firing together both run
gaps: Triggering vendor-specific reminders with a shared run_at is not expressible because no operation or case-specific request path/body is provided.
Waiting for and verifying completion of both triggers and their vendor-specific rows is outside the available vocabulary.
The setup recipes do not provide both V-NODOCS and V-NODOCS2 as invited vendors in the initial state.
